# AILoveDigital

> AILoveDigital is a Baku-based technology and creative studio. We build digital products with AI at the core, grow their audience and train the teams that run them.

And we make businesses love it too. Built with logic. Finished with love.

## Services
- Build: Web platforms, mobile apps and enterprise systems — from discovery to launch, with clean code that is yours. A first MVP in about two weeks. (Web platforms · iOS & Android apps · E-commerce & integrations · UI/UX design)
- Automate: We find the repetitive work and automate it with AI agents and integrations — quietly, in the background, with the hours it saves on record. (AI agents · Workflow automation · CRM/ERP integrations · Ops tooling)
- Grow: Content, ads, SEO and analytics in one strategy, with every manat in a monthly report. On average, engagement triples within six months. (Social media & content · Meta, Google & TikTok ads · SEO · Analytics & reporting)
- Teach: Courses, mentorship and real project work — for your team, or for the people you are about to hire. 300+ academy graduates so far. (AI & IT training · Programming, marketing & design courses · Mentorship · Corporate workshops)
- Think: We set the right direction before you invest: we assess where you stand, build a technology strategy and give you a clear action plan to base decisions on. Because sometimes the right move is to wait for a better opportunity. (Strategy · Technical audits · Digital transformation · Consulting)

## Selected work
- [Dailoq](https://ailovedigital.com/work/dailoq/): An AI customer-messaging assistant built for Azerbaijan. One assistant across Telegram, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger and the web — it answers from your documents, takes actions and hands hard questions to a human. [AI platforms, 2026]
- [RootOS](https://ailovedigital.com/work/rootos/): The AI brain that connects a company's data, people and agents. One intelligent layer over every department — it watches the processes, spots problems early and coordinates AI agents under human control. [AI platforms, 2026]
- [AgentOS](https://ailovedigital.com/work/agentos/): AI agents and developers building software together. It turns client requirements into tasks, runs specialised AI agents in parallel and keeps every change under review, tests and human approval. [AI platforms, 2026]
- [MeetOS](https://ailovedigital.com/work/meetos/): An AI platform that turns meetings into real business results. A Windows app and browser extension for Google Meet, Zoom and Teams that transcribes and translates calls, then turns decisions into tasks with owners and deadlines. [AI platforms, 2026]
- [CompanyOS](https://ailovedigital.com/work/companyos/): One AI-powered platform to run every part of a company. Departments, people, projects, sales, finance and marketing in one system — with AI agents that plan, coordinate and carry out the work. [AI platforms, 2026]
- [ChefMarket](https://ailovedigital.com/work/chefmarket/): A restaurant–supplier B2B marketplace ecosystem. Three mobile apps, an admin panel and a real-time backend — in one ecosystem. [Marketplace, 2026]
- [Vicdoor](https://ailovedigital.com/work/vicdoor/): A multi-tenant SaaS for door and window manufacturers. Quoting, visual design, production, installation and customer trust in one system. [B2B & SaaS, 2026]
- [AltisCassa](https://ailovedigital.com/work/altiscassa/): An integrated finance and cash management platform. Multi-currency cash management, counterparty debts and 11+ financial reports. [Fintech & finance, 2026]
- [e-Hesab](https://ailovedigital.com/work/e-hesab/): An AI-based pre-accounting platform. DVX integration, OCR invoices and a dynamic tax engine. [Fintech & finance, 2026]
- [E-Faktura](https://ailovedigital.com/work/e-faktura/): An offline invoicing app for small business. An invoicing solution that works without internet, fully in Azerbaijani. [Fintech & finance, 2026]
- [İnsanİş](https://ailovedigital.com/work/insanis/): A construction management system. Bridging the information gap between the office and the construction site. [B2B & SaaS, 2026]
- [Suntech](https://ailovedigital.com/work/suntech/): A domestic logistics and content management platform. Every element of the site is managed without a developer. [B2B & SaaS, 2026]
- [Nitro Garage](https://ailovedigital.com/work/nitro-garage/): An automotive service and spare parts marketplace. Driver, mechanic and store on one platform — four roles, 79+ screens. [Marketplace, 2026]
- [JobRemotely](https://ailovedigital.com/work/jobremotely/): A curated remote job board. Vacancies with publicly disclosed salaries, verified by HR and free of spam. [Marketplace, 2026]
- [Moleaks](https://ailovedigital.com/work/moleaks/): A leaked-data search platform. Deep search by email, phone number, domain and face recognition. [Cybersecurity, 2026]
- [Safemole](https://ailovedigital.com/work/safemole/): A digital security and privacy platform. Fully native iOS and Android, a hybrid database and end-to-end encryption. [Cybersecurity, 2026]
- [Rana](https://ailovedigital.com/work/rana/): A digital legacy and message-to-the-future platform. A time capsule where encrypted messages open only on a scheduled date. [Cybersecurity, 2026]
- [Guraba](https://ailovedigital.com/work/guraba/): A global e-commerce and sales ecosystem. Web, mobile and a Telegram bot — one account, one cart. [E-commerce & catalog, 2026]
- [ParkHub](https://ailovedigital.com/work/parkhub/): A unified smart parking and payment ecosystem. City parking, subscriptions and payments in one app. [Platforms & web, 2026]
- [Arsa Creative](https://ailovedigital.com/work/arsa-creative/): A creative agency and portfolio web platform. A showcase that presents creative work at the highest visual quality. [Platforms & web, 2026]
- [Marka House](https://ailovedigital.com/work/marka-house/): A branding and digital marketing platform. Brand identity and service portfolio combined in one showcase. [Platforms & web, 2026]
